guarantees.claim: prd_3_o is always assigned the concatenation {b_gamma1_omega_prd3, b_gamma0_omega_prd3}

uncertain_points.claim: The concatenation merges two masking shares onto a single bus prd_3_o; this grouping may create a combinational glitch correlation if later logic operates on the entire bus as a value, potentially weakening the domain-oriented masking separation.
uncertain_points.cond: When prd_3_o is used in a combinational path that mixes the shares
uncertain_points.risk: Reduced resistance to side-channel leakage; the masking scheme could be compromised if shares are not kept strictly independent on separate nets.
